mechanism: Perphenazine may impair gastric motility and increase risk of esophageal irritation/ulceration when combined with risedronate, a bisphosphonate requiring careful administration to avoid upper GI damage.
action: Ensure adequate spacing between drug administration (risedronate on empty stomach, 30 minutes before other medications) and monitor for GI adverse effects; consider alternative antipsychotic if GI symptoms develop.
